Figure 6.4: Sensory-feedback comparison with fixed W2L conductances, drive, and support
settings. Knee angles, heel contact forces, and displacement are shown with feedback
intact (left) and all sensory feedback disabled (right). Cycling persists in both conditions;
the feedback-disabled condition fails the bilateral contact-phase criterion.
